summary: The filing is a routine Form 6-K by InterContinental Hotels Group PLC, a foreign private issuer, reporting daily purchases of its own ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange through Goldman Sachs International. Each exhibit details aggregate share counts, price ranges, and average prices paid (e.g., $162.7580 per share on 24 August 2026), with shares intended for cancellation. The buybacks occur under shareholder authority from the May 2025 AGM and instructions issued in February 2026. No material terms such as tender offer or premium are disclosed; this is a standard issuer share repurchase disclosure, not a special situation.
